about.title: Trusted transportation from Mercabarna
about.subtitle: Family-owned transportation company with over 15 years moving fresh produce with commitment, punctuality and close service.
about.historyTitle: A story of effort and commitment
about.historyText1: This company was born from the effort of a single person who decided to start a business in the transportation sector at Mercabarna. With dedication, responsibility and many hours on the road, it grew step by step.
about.historyText2: Today, the company has three trucks and the second generation at the helm, maintaining the same values from day one: punctuality, close service and commitment to each client.
about.historyText3: We work every day to ensure your cargo arrives on time and in perfect condition.
